source_title: Ведомости Съезда народных депутатов СССР и Верховного Совета СССР, 1991, No. 35 (28 August 1991), scanned issue, Internet Archive capture 20211204065955; recorded for the CPSU

live_file_response.note: The live static file on the non-official SSSR.SU host, byte-identical to the recorded capture; requested without Accept-Encoding and served without Content-Encoding.

stability_check: This packet: downloaded at 2026-09-30T23:37:13Z and again at 2026-10-01T00:20:39Z (43 minutes later) with plain curl (curl's own User-Agent, 'Accept-Encoding: identity', no cookies, no cache-busting query, no redirect followed); identical 618,372 bytes and SHA-256; the attached responses also matched on both downloads. The base32 SHA-1 of the recorded bytes equals the Internet Archive CDX digest XBOY76DZ7UUFTRYS3MXBR444NT5FPJMC.
provenance_note: Raw Internet Archive capture (id_ form) of https://vedomosti.sssr.su/1991/35.pdf, captured at 2021-12-04T06:59:55Z, before the 7 September 2026 cutoff; requested with 'Accept-Encoding: identity' (curl without --compressed) and served without Content-Encoding, so the recorded identity is the uncompressed body as replayed (a request accepting gzip may be served gzip-encoded, with different bytes). The same bytes are served as a static file by the live host (live_file_response); the capture is recorded as the identity because it is fixed before the cutoff. The original response is not checked into this repository; this checked-in file is a derived factual extract, not the original response. Its own checksum is recorded separately in the packet.
rights_note: Attributed factual paraphrases only; no source artwork or portrait copied, and no photograph, emblem, signature image or expressive source text is republished. No open license is asserted. No portrait permission or likeness approval is established.
scope_note: The same bytes as su_ved_1991_35 (CLAUDE-C01-26), recorded under a new ID so that its extract stays unchanged. Only Art. 1024 (decree УП-2460 of 24 August 1991 on the CPSU's property) is imported, as an organization claim.

edition_and_host.edition: Ведомости, 1991, № 35; Art. 1024 on printed p. 1429 (PDF p. 23).
edition_and_host.host: SSSR.SU portal (snd.sssr.su, sten.vs.sssr.su, vedomosti.sssr.su): a non-commercial project registered as the media outlet 'Информационное агентство «СССР»' (Roskomnadzor ИА № ФС77-40345), not a state body and not the publisher; it serves page-image scans of the official publications as static files (see the CLAUDE-C01-SOURCE-26 review of the same host).

visual_review.method: Every cited page was rendered from the recorded bytes with PyMuPDF (100-150 dpi) and read from the page image, not from the OCR layer; headings, speaker lines, quotations and signature blocks were compared with the image.

rows.text: Decree of the President of the USSR 'Об имуществе Коммунистической партии Советского Союза' (Art. 1024), signed 'Президент Союза Советских Социалистических Республик М. ГОРБАЧЕВ', 'Москва, Кремль 24 августа 1991 г. № УП—2460': point 1 'Советам народных депутатов взять под охрану имущество КПСС'; point 2 provides for the employment and social security of 'работников тех партийных комитетов, которые прекращают свою деятельность'.

bounded_scope: CPSU General Secretary and Deputy General Secretary observations for CLAUDE-C01-41 only. Nomination and ballot, vote, election result, biographical election dates, vote figures, in-office attestations, resignation statements and references, acting service and the party's property, suspension and termination records stay separate rows; holder boundaries are decided in the packet, not by any row. State offices, the RSFSR Communist Party, russia.json and the simulation's party rows are outside this extract.
